title: Implement Foreshadowing Tracker panel
description: Build the Foreshadowing Tracker right panel with timeline-table layout. Displays foreshadow arcs grouped by ID, each showing plant/hint/harvest events in a collapsible tree. Uses AccordionWrapper in multi-expand mode.
action: Create desktop/src/components/ForeshadowingTrackerPanel.tsx. Import ForeshadowItem, ForeshadowStats from knowledge.ts. Import AccordionWrapper, IntelligenceBadge, SectionHeader from intelligence/. On mount, call getForeshadowStats() for summary metrics and getForeshadows() for item list. Group items by foreshadow ID and render as accordion with multi-expand mode. Each item shows status badge (planted=success, hinted=warning, harvested=danger variant), description (truncated), hints count, and date. Filter bar at top with status filter chips.

convergence.verification: Panel renders in right sidebar when sidebar button clicked. Stats summary shows total/planted/hinted/harvested counts. Accordion expands/collapses multiple items. Filter chips toggle status visibility.
convergence.definition_of_done: Foreshadowing Tracker panel fully functional with data loading, stats summary, multi-expand accordion, status badges, and filter chips.

implementation: Create ForeshadowingTrackerPanel.tsx with props { onClose: () => void }
Import useI18n from i18n, useDialogFocusTrap from hooks, AccordionWrapper/IntelligenceBadge/SectionHeader/MetricValue from intelligence/
Import getForeshadows, getForeshadowStats, ForeshadowItem, ForeshadowStats from api/knowledge
State: items (ForeshadowItem[]), stats (ForeshadowStats | null), loading, error, statusFilter ('all' | 'planted' | 'hinted' | 'harvested')
useEffect: fetch stats and items on mount, set loading/error states
Render: panel container with useDialogFocusTrap, panel title from t.intelligenceForeshadowingTrackerTitle
Stats row: 4 MetricValue components showing stats.total, stats.by_state.planted, stats.by_state.hinted, stats.by_state.harvested
Filter bar: 'all', 'planted', 'hinted', 'harvested' filter chips using IntelligenceBadge variants (all=default, planted=success, hinted=warning, harvested=danger)
Filter items by statusFilter before grouping

Group items by id, transform into AccordionWrapper items array. renderHeader shows status badge + truncated description + hints count. renderContent shows full description, planted_time, hints list (scene_id + description + timestamp), harvested_time
Pass mode='multi' to AccordionWrapper for multi-expand behavior
Style: use CSS classes .intelligence-card, .intelligence-data-row, .intelligence-section-header from globals.css

rationale.why: Foreshadowing is a core novelist tool. Timeline table layout matches MASTER.md spec for tracking planted/hinted/harvested arcs.
rationale.alternatives: Flat list without grouping — rejected because grouped accordion provides better narrative arc visibility

risks: Large foreshadow lists may need virtualization — defer to Wave 3 if performance is an issue
